name: Jan Stanzel
headline: Industrial Control · Reliable Embedded Systems & Electronics · Modern Interfaces & IoT | Managing Director
summary:
Reliable machines need reliable control — I design industrial systems that just work.
With a background in computer science, I combine embedded systems, electronics, firmware, and modern interfaces to deliver durable, practical solutions.

As Managing Director, I focus on understanding customer needs first: we deliver hardware, software, and IoT features that are reliable and maintainable. With my small, focused team, we handle projects from concept to fully integrated solution.
